title: Sleeps 12 | 5 min to Broadway! | 4 BR Cozy Duplex
description:
Located only 1.8 miles from Broadway (a 5 minute uber!) and within blocks of main thoroughfares  in the vibrant city of Nashville. Step outside your door and see the downtown skyline. The best parts of Nashville are only a hop, skip and a jump away. The home is an artsy and unique newly renovated triplex with everything being brand new. Some of Nashville's newest and most exciting new restaurants are just a 10 minute walk away! Get your Music City adventure underway, Book Now!

The space
This listing offers 2 separate units in our modern triplex, where comfort meets style in each private unit. Perfect for separate stays or larger groups renting multiple units!

Key Features:

✤ Modern Renovation: Recently renovated with hardwood floors, granite countertops, and a crisp white aesthetic throughout.
✤ Entertainment Hub: Enjoy a 55" flat-screen Fire TV in the living room, complemented by additional Fire TVs in both bedrooms.
✤ Comfortable Living: Sink into cloud-like beds or unwind on the sofa for a cozy retreat. Your relaxation is our top priority.
✤ Convenient Amenities: A well-equipped kitchen invites you to whip up a cup of coffee or prepare a delightful meal.
✤ Prime Location: Situated within a mile or two of fantastic attractions, including Downtown and East Nashville's delectable restaurants.
✤ Parking Made Easy: Designated off-street parking with room for 2 cars, ensuring stress-free arrivals and departures.
✤ Free Coffee!
✤ Shampoo/bodywash provided!
✤ Fully fenced in yard featuring yard games, a fire pit, and seating!
✤ Free in-unit washer and dryer
✤ Only a 5 minute uber from the fun and music of Lower Broadway!!

Sleeping Arrangements:

Unit A
✤ Bedroom 1: 1 Queen bed
✤ Bedroom 2: 1 Queen bed
✤ Living Room: 2 love seats that fold out into twin beds, 1 Sofa bed that folds out into a very nice-sized bed

Unit B
✤ Bedroom 1: 1 Queen bed
✤ Bedroom 2: 1 Queen bed
✤ Living Room: 2 love seats that fold out into twin beds, 1 Sofa bed that folds out into a very nice-sized bed

Whether you're exploring the nearby attractions or indulging in a tranquil night's sleep, our triplex provides the ideal backdrop for your Nashville adventure. Book your stay now and experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience!

Please note: The property consists of two separate, side-by-side townhome units. The units do NOT have an interior/adjoining door connecting them. Guests must enter each unit through its separate exterior entrance.

Guest access
Guests have full access to Units A and B.

Other things to note
ATTENTION LOCAL GUESTS: All locals must send an 'inquiry' first using the 'Contact Host' option on the booking page to state the purpose of your visit, so we can check to see if we would be able to accommodate your stay; otherwise, we reserve the right to cancel any confirmed reservation made without our approval.

The units are cleaned by a specialized short-term rental cleaning company. The yard is fully fenced in. All the units are completely separated. The house also has exterior cameras on the rear of the house for added security. It is recommended that guests lock their cars doors and remove valuables from the car. The unit is approx. 750 square feet. Pets are more than welcome; however, there is a pet fee that will be collected immediately after booking.
